---
title: "Venn"
description: "Visualize intersections among a small number of protein or gene sets."
---

## When to use a Venn diagram

Venn diagrams are useful for a small number of clearly defined ID sets, such as significant proteins from two or three contrasts. They are not ideal for many sets; use an UpSet-style approach outside the module when intersections become difficult to read.

## Workflow

1. Prepare each set using the same identifier namespace.
2. Remove empty IDs and accidental duplicates within each set.
3. Load the sets into the Venn module.
4. Confirm set names and intersection counts.
5. Export both the figure and, when needed, the IDs belonging to biologically important intersections.

::: {.callout-note}
An overlap count is descriptive. Whether the overlap is more than expected by chance requires an explicit statistical test and a defined background universe.
:::
